Tooltip_DD_LightTimer: Install on a placed grow lamp. 18/6 keeps plants in veg; 12/12 flips them to flower. Lamps without a timer run 24/0.
Tooltip_DD_FloodTimer: Install on a flood reservoir. While it has power and water it floods the tables a few times a day, so the rockwool never dries out.
Tooltip_DD_GrowRoomPanel: Mount on a wall inside a room. Every grow lamp in that room runs the panel's schedule, and the lamps' own timers come off.
Tooltip_DD_BlackoutCurtain: Hang on a door or window frame of a grow room to block light in its dark hours. Right-click the frame. A sheet hung and drawn shut does the same job.
Tooltip_DD_ExhaustFan: Mount on a wall inside a grow room. Pulls hot, humid air out; full effect on an outside wall, a quarter on a wall to another room. Needs panel power.
Tooltip_DD_IntakeFan: Mount on a wall inside a grow room. Brings outside air in; pair it with an exhaust fan. Full effect on an outside wall. Needs panel power.
Tooltip_DD_Heater: Stand in a grow room. The panel switches it on when the room is too cold. Needs panel power.
Tooltip_DD_Dehumidifier: Stand in a grow room. The panel switches it on when the air is too humid. Needs panel power.
Tooltip_DD_Humidifier: Stand in a grow room. The panel switches it on when the air is too dry. Needs panel power.
Tooltip_DD_WallAC: Mount on any wall inside a grow room. The panel runs it when the room is too hot: about 6 C (11 F) cooler per unit whatever the weather, never below 12 C (54 F), and a little drier. Needs panel power.
Tooltip_DD_CirculationFan: Mount on any wall inside a grow room. Keeps the air moving so lamp hot spots don't build up: about 1.5 C (3 F) cooler each, 3 C (5 F) at most. Needs panel power.
Tooltip_DD_DripTank: Holds every soil pot in its grow room (or within a few tiles outside one) at about 70 percent water with a slow drip. Fill its 50 L tank by hand or with a water line, which keeps it topped up. Add nutrients and it feeds the pots too. The pump needs power.
Tooltip_DD_FanLeaf: A big fan leaf off a cannabis plant. Hang it on a drying rack: it dries in about a day.
Tooltip_DD_DriedFanLeaf: A dried fan leaf. Cure it in a curing jar for about 3 days (burp it like buds) and it becomes a hemp wrap for blunts.
Tooltip_DD_CuredTobacco: Dried tobacco cured in a curing jar or barrel. Shred it with scissors or a sharp knife for twice the loose tobacco.
Tooltip_DD_MoldyCuredTobacco: Dried tobacco that went moldy in the jar. Ruined: it can't be shredded.
Tooltip_DD_CuredFanLeaf: A cured fan leaf: a hemp wrap. Roll a blunt from it and two buds (right-click a bud).
Tooltip_DD_Blunt: Two buds rolled in a wrap. Stronger and longer than a joint, smoked over 3 sessions; it's put out after each to relight later with a lighter. A tobacco-leaf blunt gives nicotine too.
Tooltip_DD_HalfSmokedBlunt: A blunt put out for later. Relight it with a lighter or an open flame to smoke the next session.
